records.name: T21 Club of the Delaware Valley
records.summary: A club that works for the awareness and inclusion of people born with Down syndrome in Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Delaware. It holds awareness events and runs fundraisers, such as a sock sale.
records.what_you_do: Follow its awareness events, such as the Phillies event held May 18, 2026, or order its Rock Your Socks to support the work.

first_step.how: Email the club at T21clubofdelval@gmail.com to ask about its next awareness event and how to get involved.

records.notes: The club's own site lists a Phillies awareness event dated May 18, 2026. The Rock Your Socks sale has a deadline written as March 11 with no year, so it is not used as evidence. The page does not describe membership or meeting times, so drop-in and newcomer fields are left out. Facebook link is the club's group page as published.

records.name: Action for Justice Collective
records.summary: A youth nonprofit that runs school-based mentoring, a program for young women ages 12 to 21, and a gaming and esports program for youth affected by gun violence.
records.what_you_do: Young people take part in mentoring at schools, gaming and esports activities, and life skills or career exploration. Volunteers sign up through the group's volunteer page.

first_step.how: Sign up through the volunteer page at afjcollective.org/become-a-volunteer, then ask which youth program needs help.
first_step.basis: A volunteer page exists, but no events, dates or program schedule are published, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: Working site with no dated events, news or posts; the Events page says coming soon, so status is probably_active on the no-dates rule. records.name: Black Science Coalition and Institute
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit whose board is made up of Black scientists and science supporters. It makes a science podcast and a magazine, and holds photo and story contests on everyday science.
records.what_you_do: Listen to the B-Scientists podcast or read the magazine. The 2026 photo and story contest took entries until Sept. 25, 2026, and the page says that deadline may be extended.

first_step.how: Listen to the B-Scientists podcast or follow the group on Instagram to hear about the next photo contest.
first_step.basis: No membership or volunteer route is described; the public way in is the podcast and a contest limited to U.S.-based scientists, storytellers and journalists.

records.notes: Headquartered in Philadelphia per its site, but programs are online and national in reach, so check the Philadelphia fit at review. No street address is published.
